an7.27:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] satta vo bhikkhave, aparihānīye dhamme desissāmi.
an7.27:1.3: katame ca bhikkhave, satta aparihānīyā dhammā:
an7.27:1.4: yāvakīvañca bhikkhave, bhikkhū aniccasaññaṃ bhāvessantī, vuddhiyeva bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā no parihānīti.
an7.27:3.1: vuddhiyeva bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā no parihāni. yāvakīvañca bhikkhave, ime satta aparihānīyā dhammā bhikkhūsu ṭhassanti, imesu ca sattasu aparihānīyesu dhammesu bhikkhū sandissanti, vuddhiyeva bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā no parihānīti.
